brand_identity.name: ORATO
brand_identity.archetype: Organic & Earthy (Trust, Growth, Calm) + Swiss Precision

rules.headings: Use serif fonts for H1-H3. Letter-spacing: tight. Weights: Light (300) or Black (900) - avoid standard Bold.
rules.body: Use sans-serif for UI text, inputs, and long-form reading. Line-height: relaxed.

usage_rules.gradients: Avoid full-screen gradients. Use subtle noise textures or 'spotlight' gradients (radial) for depth.
usage_rules.borders: Use 1px borders with 10-20% opacity for structure. Do not rely solely on shadows.

layout.spacing_system: Tailwind Scale (p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24, p-32). Use 2x standard spacing for 'Premium' feel.

marketing_tetris.description: Asymmetrical grid for Landing Page. Mix 3+ shapes.

items: Main Chart: col-span-2 row-span-2 or col-span-3

components.strategy: Hybrid: Custom HTML for Layouts, Shadcn for Interactions.

shadcn_customization.radius: 0.5rem (Rounded-lg) or 0px (Sharp) - Choose Sharp for 'Swiss' feel, Rounded for 'Organic'. Recommendation: Rounded-md (6px).
shadcn_customization.shadows: Soft, diffuse ambient shadows (shadow-sm, shadow-md). Avoid harsh black shadows.
shadcn_customization.inputs: bg-transparent border-b border-input focus:border-primary (Underline style) OR bg-secondary/50 border-transparent (Filled style).

specific_components.buttons: Pill-shaped for primary actions. Text-only with arrow for secondary.
specific_components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover: Lift + Shadow.

visual_enhancers.textures: Add subtle grain/noise overlay to the background to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for sticky headers and floating controls. bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-border/50.

motion.rules: Stagger children animations. Use 'layout' prop for smooth resizing.

hero_background.description: Abstract sound wave shapes (Dark/Red/Blue) - Use with overlay or mix-blend-mode
hero_background.alt: Abstract visualization of sound and rhythm

hero_secondary.description: Concentric blue lines - Good for 'Focus' or 'Eye Contact' section background

features.description: Man standing in front of microphone
Serene workspace with plant and lamp

instructions_to_main_agent.file_types: Use .jsx for components (as per project structure).
instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Use Tailwind classes exclusively. Do not write custom CSS unless absolutely necessary for complex animations.
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use lucide-react (default) or @phosphor-icons/react for a more premium look if available.
instructions_to_main_agent.charts: Use Recharts (via Shadcn Charts) for the Analytics Dashboard.
instructions_to_main_agent.video: Use native <video> tag or 'react-player' for the Evaluation module. Ensure custom controls matching the theme.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid 'AI Slop': Do not use generic centered layouts or default blue/purple gradients.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
